entities.summary: Agricultural Museum is a museum about agriculture in Jasin Town, Jasin District, Malacca, Malaysia. The museum building was originally the first post office in Jasin Town before it was converted into a museum, which opened to the public in October 1990. The museum displays the historical activities and the economy of the local Jasin people, especially in the fields of agriculture.
